correctness.rationale: The arithmetic was independently reconstructed from the two Hirzebruch--Jung strings. Their determinants and tail determinants are \((73,66)\) and \((87,70)\), giving quotient types \(1/73(1,66)\) and \(1/87(1,70)\) and local canonical indices 73 and 87. Their least common multiple is 6351, so with \(K_X^2=1/6351\) the index-volume product is one. Solving the discrepancy linear systems gives exactly the vectors printed in RESULT.md. Substitution into Blache's correction formula using exact rational arithmetic yields integer plurigenera: zero for degrees 2 through 10, one at 11, no value above one through 97, and two at 98, with the listed degree-one-section set. The inspected verifier recomputes every rational step and every claimed degree; the finite computation is exhaustive for the explicitly bounded threshold claim.
